overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance indicates that deep relationship dynamics, specifically husband-wife emotional realities (e.g., 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?', 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए'), significantly outperform family-member appreciation posts or generic shayari. The audience responds heavily to marital friction and relationship introspection.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos about husband-wife dynamics garnered the highest views (1766 and 1666 views respectively), outperforming general family or solo shayari.
winning_patterns.action: Allocate 70% of upcoming content to complex husband-wife and modern relationship dynamics.

weak_patterns.pattern: Generic Sad Shayari / Solo Text Focus
weak_patterns.evidence: Clips focusing purely on abstract heartbreak or general sad thoughts (like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा') generated very low traction (<15 views).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid generic text-heavy shayari and tie emotional lines directly to concrete, everyday situations.
